note: What the collegiate collector reads (collegiate/run.js, collegiate-rosters.yml). weekly: every listed sport's current season and the one before, at every school of the division, every week. backfill: past seasons read once (a backfill item is done when collegiate/data/backfill.json records it). Changing this file on a branch runs the collector on that branch. Started small (baseball only, no backfill) to check the collector at full scale before widening.
